info.title: Grandway Policy-Registered API
info.description: Generated from the Core Policy Engine registry (source of truth for endpoints, permission keys, HTTP methods, and risk levels). Request/response body schemas are documented per app in `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List every applicant. Shared across the consultancy — not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create an applicant directly, with no preceding lead. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one applicant with contacts, addresses, passport, family, and emergency contacts.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct identity, contact, address, passport, family, or emergency-contact information.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List an applicant's chronological change history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Set the applicant's standing: active, dormant, or archived. Always manual.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List and filter the central audit log (Admin/Superadmin).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve a single audit event by id (Admin/Superadmin).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Authenticate with username + password (+ device_id) and open a revocable session.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Revoke the caller's current session (logout of this device).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Return the currently authenticated user and forced-password-change state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Disable the caller's own MFA after confirming password + a current code.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Create a pending TOTP device and return its secret + otpauth URL.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Confirm a pending TOTP enrollment with a current code, activating MFA.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Change the caller's own password after confirming the current one.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Rotate the refresh session, issuing a new access + refresh credential.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the caller's own active sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Revoke one, all-but-current, or all of the caller's own sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List accounts within the caller's managed authority tier.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create a subordinate account (superadmin→admin, admin→lead manager).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve a single managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit permitted profile fields of a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Deactivate a managed account and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List authentication audit events for a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Remove a managed account's MFA device and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Set a temporary password on a managed account and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Reactivate a blocked managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a managed account's active sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Revoke one or all active sessions of a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one site with its institution and availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a site's name, city, notes, or availability. The owning institution is immutable; a non-active status requires a note.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List destination countries with their availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a destination country. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one country with its availability and counselling notes.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a country's name, notes, or availability. Setting a non-active status requires a note. The code is immutable.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the study-area classifications used to group and search programs.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a study-area classification. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one study-area classification.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a study field's name, ordering, or active flag. The code is immutable.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List providers, filterable by country, type, availability, and name search.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a provider under an existing country. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one provider with its country and availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a provider's name, type, country, notes, or availability. Setting a non-active status requires a note.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List one institution's sites. Nested under the institution that owns them.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a site to a provider. The institution comes from the URL and never changes. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
The shortlisting search. Filters by country, institution, campus, level, field, availability, scholarship, tuition ceiling, and free-text query. Returns only usable records unless asked otherwise.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a study offering under an institution, with optional campus, tuition, entry expectations, and scholarship notes. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one program with its full entry expectations, tuition caveats, and notes.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a program's classification, duration, intake, tuition, entry expectations, scholarship, or availability. The institution is immutable; a campus must belong to it; a tuition amount requires a currency and period.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Browse the B2B partner directory. Shared — every Admin and Lead Manager may read it.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a partner organization to the directory, with its spokesperson and contact numbers.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one client with its full contact details, numbers, and standing.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a client's name, spokesperson, contact details, or notes. Standing is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a client's chronological change history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return a retired partner to current use, clearing the retirement state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Withdraw a partner from current use, recording why. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List one document's print snapshots, newest version first. Bodies are omitted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Freeze the document's current body and render context as a new immutable version.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List one document's print timeline: captures, reprints, and recoveries, newest first.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve one frozen snapshot in full. The only endpoint that returns a snapshot body.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Restore a frozen body into the working document. The snapshot itself is never altered.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record a reprint of an existing snapshot. Creates a print event, never a new snapshot.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List document working records across applicants and standalone documents. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Open a new editable document against an applicant, or as a standalone record.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List applicants with live documents, each with a count and the most recent edit.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve one document including its full body. The only endpoint that returns content.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Save the workspace — label, body, notes. Owner, family, template, and status are unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Retire a document from active work with a mandatory reason. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a document's chronological history. Body changes appear as a marker, not as content.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return an archived document to draft so it can be edited again.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a document between draft and ready. Cannot set archived.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List study objectives across all applicants. Shared, not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record a new overseas-study objective for an existing applicant.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one journey with its objective details and lifecycle state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct destination, level, field, intake, budget, or notes. Stage is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
End a journey with a mandatory outcome. Successful completes it; anything else closes it.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Pause a journey to a later intake, recording the target intake and reason.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a journey's chronological action history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return a completed, closed, or deferred journey to an active stage.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a journey between active stages. Cannot set completed, closed, or deferred.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List leads in the caller's scope: own leads for a Lead Manager, all for an Admin.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record a new enquiry. The creator owns the lead permanently.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the configurable reasons a lead may be closed with.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a configurable loss reason. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit or deactivate a loss reason. Admin only; entries are never deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the configurable lead sources a lead may be attributed to.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a configurable lead source. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit or deactivate a lead source. Admin only; entries are never deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve a single in-scope lead with its contact numbers and study interest.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct identity, contact, source, or study-interest information. Stage is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create an applicant and an initial journey from the lead, link both permanently, and move the lead to its terminal converted stage. Admin only; idempotent.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record that manual follow-up occurred, optionally with a note and a stage change.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a lead's chronological action history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Close a lead as lost with a mandatory reason. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the notes recorded against a lead, newest first.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Append a note to a lead. Notes are append-only — there is no edit or delete.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return a lost or converted lead to an active stage, preserving all history.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a lead between active stages. Cannot set lost or converted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List admission decisions across journeys. Shared, not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record an institution's admission decision against an applicant journey.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a condition's type, wording, due date, or ordering. Status is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Mark a condition satisfied, waived, not applicable, or pending again.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one offer with its snapshot, money figures, conditions, and decision.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct dates, tuition, scholarship, deposit, or notes. Snapshot and status are unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the requirements attached to one offer, in display order.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Attach a requirement to an offer. Allowed even after the offer has been decided.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record accept, reject, withdraw, defer, or expire. A decision is final and is never reopened.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List an offer's chronological history, including its condition events.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Mark a drafted offer as issued and awaiting the applicant's response.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.
